      "text": "\n\n\nTo automate your osu! mappool spreadsheet exactly the way you described—where you simply paste the **MAP ID** and all the other data (Image, Title, SR, BPM, Length, CS, and AR) populates itself—you can use a **Google Apps Script** tied to the **osu! API**. \n\nThis is the standard and most reliable method used by osu! tournament organizers. Here is a complete, step-by-step guide to setting this up:\n\n### Step 1: Get your osu! API Key\nYou will need a free legacy osu! API key to allow your spreadsheet to ask the osu! servers for beatmap data.\n1. Log into the osu! website.\n2. Go to the Legacy API page: https://osu.ppy.sh/p/api\n3. Fill out any application name (e.g., \"Mappool Sheet\") and generate your key. Copy the **API key** it gives you.\n\n### Step 2: Add the Auto-Fill Script to Google Sheets\n1. Open your Google Sheet.\n2. From the top menu, go to **Extensions \u003e Apps Script**.\n3. Delete any code in the editor and **paste the script below**.\n4. Replace `\"YOUR_API_KEY_HERE\"` at the very top with the key you just generated.\n\n```javascript\nconst API_KEY \u003d \"YOUR_API_KEY_HERE\";\n\nfunction onMapIdPaste(e) {\n  if (!e || !e.range) return;\n  const sheet \u003d e.source.getActiveSheet();\n  const range \u003d e.range;\n  \n  // COLUMN SETTINGS: \n  // MAP ID is in Column J (the 10th letter of the alphabet).\n  const mapIdColumn \u003d 10; \n  \n  // Check if the edit happened in the Map ID column, ignoring header rows (1 and 2)\n  if (range.getColumn() !\u003d\u003d mapIdColumn || range.getRow() \u003c 3) return;\n  \n  const numRows \u003d range.getNumRows();\n  const startRow \u003d range.getRow();\n  const values \u003d range.getValues();\n  \n  for (let i \u003d 0; i \u003c numRows; i++) {\n    const mapId \u003d values[i][0];\n    const row \u003d startRow + i;\n    \n    // If you delete a Map ID, clear the data in that row automatically\n    if (!mapId) {\n      sheet.getRange(row, 4, 1, 6).clearContent(); // Clears Title through AR\n      sheet.getRange(row, 2).clearContent();       // Clears Image\n      continue;\n    }\n    \n    const url \u003d `https://osu.ppy.sh/api/get_beatmaps?k\u003d${API_KEY}\u0026b\u003d${mapId}`;\n    try {\n      const response \u003d UrlFetchApp.fetch(url, {muteHttpExceptions: true});\n      if (response.getResponseCode() \u003d\u003d\u003d 200) {\n        const data \u003d JSON.parse(response.getContentText());\n        if (data \u0026\u0026 data.length \u003e 0) {\n          const map \u003d data[0];\n          \n          // Format the data to match your screenshot\n          const title \u003d `${map.artist} - ${map.title} [${map.version}]`;\n          const sr \u003d \"★\" + parseFloat(map.difficultyrating).toFixed(2);\n          const bpm \u003d Math.round(parseFloat(map.bpm));\n          \n          const totalSeconds \u003d parseInt(map.total_length);\n          const mins \u003d Math.floor(totalSeconds / 60);\n          const secs \u003d (totalSeconds % 60).toString().padStart(2, \u00270\u0027);\n          const len \u003d `${mins}:${secs}`;\n          \n          const cs \u003d parseFloat(map.diff_size);\n          const ar \u003d parseFloat(map.diff_approach);\n          \n          // osu! map cover image\n          const coverUrl \u003d `https://assets.ppy.sh/beatmaps/${map.beatmapset_id}/covers/list.jpg`;\n          \n          // WRITE TO SHEET:\n          // Column D is column index 4. This writes 6 cells across: Title, SR, BPM, LEN, CS, AR\n          sheet.getRange(row, 4, 1, 6).setValues([[title, sr, bpm, len, cs, ar]]);\n          \n          // Column B is column index 2. This writes the Image formula.\n          sheet.getRange(row, 2).setFormula(`\u003dIMAGE(\"${coverUrl}\")`);\n        }\n      }\n    } catch (error) {\n      // Skips quietly on error\n    }\n    // Small delay to prevent API timeouts if you copy-paste many IDs at once\n    Utilities.sleep(200); \n  }\n}\n```\n5. Click the **Save** icon 💾 at the top of the editor.\n\n### Step 3: Activate the Trigger (Crucial Step)\nGoogle Sheets requires permission to let a script run automatically in the background. We need to assign this script to an \"On Edit\" trigger.\n1. On the left-hand sidebar of the Apps Script page, click on the **Clock icon** ⏰ (Triggers).\n2. In the bottom right corner, click the large **+ Add Trigger** button.\n3. Configure the settings exactly like this:\n   * **Choose which function to run:** `onMapIdPaste`\n   * **Choose which deployment should run:** `Head`\n   * **Select event source:** `From spreadsheet`\n   * **Select event type:** `On edit`\n4. Click **Save**. \n5. *Note: Google will likely pop up a warning saying \"Google hasn\u0027t verified this app.\" Click **Advanced**, and then click **Go to Untitled project (unsafe)**. Click **Allow** on the next screen.*\n\n### You\u0027re done!\nNow, go back to your Google Sheet and paste a Map ID like `5373540` into column **J**. You will see the script run for a brief split second, physically typing the stats across the sheet and spawning the image on the left!\n\n**A few notes about this configuration:**\n* Because I added a loop to the script, you can confidently copy-paste **5 or 10 Map IDs all at once** down Column J, and it will fill all of them flawlessly.\n* If you delete a Map ID from a cell, the script will notice and automatically erase the adjacent stats for you so the row becomes clean.",

      "text": "\n\n\nAh, I see the exact problem in your screenshot! \n\nLook right next to the title of your document (\"BPM x THSL tourney\") in the top left corner.       "text": "\n\n\nAh, the dreaded giant `continueUrl` loop! Mappools spreadsheet.\n4. Go to **Extensions \u003e Apps Script**, click the ⏰ **Triggers** icon, and set up your \"On edit\" trigger again.\n5. When it asks for permission, click through the warnings (*Advanced \u003e Go to Untitled project (unsafe) \u003e Allow*). \n6. Because there are no other conflicting Google accounts in this Incognito window, it will succeed immediately! You can then close the Incognito window and go back to your normal browser.\n\n### Alternative Fix 1: Chrome Profiles\nIf you use Google Chrome, instead of mixing multiple Google accounts in one browser window, click your profile picture in the very top right of Chrome and click **Add**.       "text": "\n\n\nUsing custom spreadsheet formulas (like `\u003dSUM()` or `\u003dVLOOKUP()`) is actually a **much better and easier way** to do this! \n\nBy creating our own custom functions, you won\u0027t have to deal with triggers, authorizations, or background scripts failing silently. We can make a function called `\u003dOSUSTATS()` that you just type directly into the cell. \n\nEven better: I have designed this so you can paste **either the plain Map ID** (`5373540`) **or the full URL** (`https://osu.ppy.sh/beatmapsets/2457665#osu/5373540`) into the box, and it will automatically extract the exact ID and load it!\n\nHere is how to switch to the formula method:\n\n### Step 1: Replace the Code\n1. Go back to **Extensions \u003e Apps Script**.\n2. First, let\u0027s delete the old trigger so it doesn\u0027t run in the background. Click the ⏰ **Triggers** icon on the left, hover over the `onMapIdPaste` trigger, click the three dots (`⋮`) on the right, and click **Delete**.\n3. Click the `\u003c \u003e` **Editor** icon on the left to go back to the code.\n4. Delete everything there and paste this new code:\n\n```javascript\nconst API_KEY \u003d \"YOUR_API_KEY_HERE\"; \n\n/**\n * Fills all beatmap stats (Title, SR, BPM, Length, CS, AR).\n * @param {string} input The osu! beatmap ID or URL.\n * @customfunction\n */\nfunction OSUSTATS(input) {\n  if (!input) return \"\";\n  \n  let mapId \u003d extractMapId(input);\n  if (!mapId) return \"Invalid ID/URL\";\n\n  const url \u003d `https://osu.ppy.sh/api/get_beatmaps?k\u003d${API_KEY}\u0026b\u003d${mapId}`;\n  const response \u003d UrlFetchApp.fetch(url, {muteHttpExceptions: true});\n  \n  if (response.getResponseCode() !\u003d\u003d 200) return \"API Error\";\n  const data \u003d JSON.parse(response.getContentText());\n  if (!data || data.length \u003d\u003d\u003d 0) return \"Map not found\";\n  \n  const map \u003d data[0];\n  const title \u003d `${map.artist} - ${map.title} [${map.version}]`;\n  const sr \u003d \"★\" + parseFloat(map.difficultyrating).toFixed(2);\n  const bpm \u003d Math.round(parseFloat(map.bpm));\n  \n  const totalSeconds \u003d parseInt(map.total_length);\n  const mins \u003d Math.floor(totalSeconds / 60);\n  const secs \u003d (totalSeconds % 60).toString().padStart(2, \u00270\u0027);\n  const len \u003d `${mins}:${secs}`;\n  \n  const cs \u003d parseFloat(map.diff_size);\n  const ar \u003d parseFloat(map.diff_approach);\n  \n  // This creates a single row that spills across 6 columns in your sheet!\n  return [[title, sr, bpm, len, cs, ar]];\n}\n\n/**\n * Gets the osu! beatmap cover image URL.\n * @param {string} input The osu! beatmap ID or URL.\n * @customfunction\n */\nfunction OSUCOVER(input) {\n  if (!input) return \"\";\n  \n  let mapId \u003d extractMapId(input);\n  if (!mapId) return \"\";\n\n  const url \u003d `https://osu.ppy.sh/api/get_beatmaps?k\u003d${API_KEY}\u0026b\u003d${mapId}`;\n  const response \u003d UrlFetchApp.fetch(url, {muteHttpExceptions: true});\n  \n  if (response.getResponseCode() !\u003d\u003d 200) return \"\";\n  const data \u003d JSON.parse(response.getContentText());\n  if (!data || data.length \u003d\u003d\u003d 0) return \"\";\n  \n  return `https://assets.ppy.sh/beatmaps/${data[0].beatmapset_id}/covers/list.jpg`;\n}\n\n// Helper function to cleverly rip the difficulty ID out of any osu! link\nfunction extractMapId(input) {\n  const str \u003d input.toString().trim();\n  const newSiteMatch \u003d str.match(/#(osu|taiko|fruits|mania)\\/(\\d+)/);\n  if (newSiteMatch) return newSiteMatch[2];\n  const oldSiteMatch \u003d str.match(/\\/(b|osu)\\/(\\d+)/);\n  if (oldSiteMatch) return oldSiteMatch[2];\n  return str.replace(/\\D/g, \u0027\u0027); // Fallback: just extracts numbers\n}\n```\n5. Put your API Key back into the top line where it says `\"YOUR_API_KEY_HERE\"`.\n6. Click the 💾 **Save** icon. You can now close the Apps Script tab forever! No triggers needed.\n\n---\n\n### Step 2: How to use it in your spreadsheet\nBecause of how we wrote the script, `OSUSTATS` returns an \"Array\". This means you only type it into ONE box, and it magically spreads the data across all 6 columns automatically. \n\nAssuming your **NM1** row is Row 3, here is how you set it up:\n\n1. **Paste a Map ID or URL:** \n   Go to your MAP ID column (Column J) and paste `5373540` or `https://osu.ppy.sh/beatmapsets/2457665#osu/5373540`.\n2. **Get the Stats:** \n   Click on the **Title** box (Column D) for that row and type:\n   `\u003dOSUSTATS(J3)`\n   Hit enter. It will say \"Loading...\" for a second, and then *Title, SR, BPM, LEN, CS, and AR* will all instantly fill in right next to each other!\n3. **Get the Image:** \n   Click on the **Image** box (Column B) and type:\n   `\u003dIMAGE(OSUCOVER(J3))`\n   Hit enter, and the beatmap background will appear.\n\nNow, you can just **drag those formulas down** the rest of your D and B columns exactly like you would with normal Excel formulas. Anytime you paste a new URL or ID into the J column, the row will automatically process it!",

      "text": "That is very easy to do! Since this custom function returns data directly to the cell, we just need to tell the script to return a standard Google Sheets `\u003dHYPERLINK(\"url\", \"text\")` formula for the title box. \n\nYou only need to change **one line of code** in your script to make the text clickable without any link clutter.\n\n### How to add the hyperlink:\n\n1.       "parts": [{
        "text": "That is very"
      }, {
        "text": " easy to do! Since this custom function returns data directly to the cell, we"
      }, {
        "text": " just need to tell the script to return a standard Google Sheets `\u003dHYPERLINK(\"url\", \"text\")` formula for"
      }, {
        "text": " the title box. \n\nYou only need to change **one line of code** in your script to make the text clickable"
      }, {
        "text": " without any link clutter.\n\n### How to add the hyperlink:\n\n1. Open **Extensions \u003e Apps Script** again."
      }, {
        "text": "\n2. Find this specific block of code inside the `OSUSTATS` function (it\u0027s around line 22"
      }, {
        "text": "):\n\n```javascript\n  const map \u003d data[0];\n  const title \u003d `${map.artist} -"
      }, {
        "text": " ${map.title} [${map.version}]`;\n  const sr \u003d \"★\" + parseFloat(map"
      }, {
        "text": ".difficultyrating).toFixed(2);\n```\n\n3. Replace the `const title \u003d ...` line with"
      }, {
        "text": " these two lines:\n```javascript\n  const mapUrl \u003d `https://osu.ppy.sh/b/${"
      }, {
        "text": "mapId}`;\n  const title \u003d `\u003dHYPERLINK(\"${mapUrl}\", \"${map.artist} - ${map"
      }, {
        "text": ".title} [${map.version}]\")`;\n```\n\n4. Click the 💾 **Save** icon"
      }, {
        "text": ".\n\n### That\u0027s it!\nGo back to your spreadsheet. Google Sheets might take a few seconds to naturally"
      }, {
        "text": " refresh the data, but if you want to force it to update immediately, just delete the `\u003dOSUSTATS(J9)` formula"
      }, {
        "text": " and hit `Ctrl+Z` (Undo) to put it right back.\n\nThe title will now show up normally"
      }, {
        "text": " (`44teru-k remixed wa. - Isetsu Higanbana...`), but if you hover"
      }, {
        "text": " over it or click it, it will act as a direct link straight to the beatmap page!"
